subject: Renewal: hybrid capacity top-up and model-mix onboarding (long-context + rankstack)
participants_external: kate@strataretail.com (Kate Lowry, Head of AI Platform)
messages:
From: marcus.lin@redwood.ai
To: kate@strataretail.com
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 10 Dec 2026 09:15:00 -0800
Subject: Renewal conversation + capacity proposal for StrataRetail

Hi Kate,

Thanks again for the time last week. As discussed, I put together a proposal for the Dedicated capacity top-up tied to your renewal. High level: add a hybrid burst pool (reserved + burstable capacity) to support the new 24k-context model and the RankStack reranker workload.

Proposal summary:
- Reserved baseline: +8 x A100 equivalent GPUs (adds to your existing 12)
- Hybrid burst: up to +4 GPUs available on demand for traffic spikes
- Committed throughput: 120k inference tokens/day across the mix; 99th pct latency SLO tiers for the baseline pool
- Term: 18 months (to cover model-mix onboarding and performance tuning)
- One-time onboarding/setup fee: $18,000 (includes longer-context pipeline validation and KV cache tuning)
- Add-on: RankStack reranker license + $0.02 per 1k ranking ops

I attached a draft capacity plan and a redlineable SOW. Can we schedule a 30-min call next Tue to walk through operational changes and a target go-live?

Best,
Marcus Lin
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.ai
[Attachment: SOW_StrataRetail_Dedicated_Addendum_v2.pdf]
From: kate@strataretail.com (Kate Lowry)
To: marcus.lin@redwood.ai
Date: Sat, 12 Dec 2026 11:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Renewal conversation + capacity proposal for StrataRetail

Marcus,

Appreciate the clear summary. We are aligned on the need for longer context and the reranker — our search team will be moving RankStack to production Q1 and we expect a 1.6x increase in ranking QPS. A couple of asks from procurement and engineering:
- Procurement needs estimated TCO (annualized) and an outline of billing milestones for the 18-month term.
- Engineering wants to know the GPU impact if RankStack is enabled at 2x expected QPS (safety margin). Would +4 reserved GPUs be sufficient in that scenario?

I'll loop in procurement (procurement@strataretail.com) if you can provide a PO-friendly SOW and a short runbook for the onboarding steps. Target go-live: Feb 1, 2027.

Thanks,
Kate
Kate Lowry
Head of AI Platform, StrataRetail
[Attachment: procurement_timeline.xlsx]
From: marissa.cole@redwood.ai
To: marcus.lin@redwood.ai, soojin.lee@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 13 Dec 2026 08:30:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Renewal conversation + capacity proposal for StrataRetail

Marcus / Soojin,

Quick notes on capacity sizing and commercial levers:
- Given RankStack will increase evening QPS by ~60% in your estimate and the longer-context model (24k) roughly doubles per-token GPU footprint for decoding, plan for an additional safety buffer. I recommend we propose: +10 reserved GPUs (instead of +8) and keep +4 burst for spikes. This keeps latency SLOs stable during retrains and early tuning.
- Pricing suggestion: 12% discount on baseline reserved pool for an 18-month commit, waive the one-time onboarding fee if they commit to a 12-month prepayment schedule (offer credit equivalent).
- Ops/action: update SOW with explicit fallback policy (downgrade to 16k-context variant and reduced throughput) and a three-week ramp plan for RankStack.

Draft attachment: updated capacity_plan_v3.xlsx has the math. I'll also prepare a short note for commercial about a one-time onboarding credit to close.

Marissa
VP, Customer Success
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: capacity_plan_v3.xlsx]
From: marcus.lin@redwood.ai
To: kate@strataretail.com, procurement@strataretail.com
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.ai, soojin.lee@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 16 Dec 2026 10:12:00 -0800
Subject: Updated SOW & commercial (per engineering ask)

Hi Kate + procurement team,

Thanks for the quick reply. Based on engineering's margin request we've updated the SOW and capacity plan:
- Reserved baseline increase: +10 x A100-equiv GPUs (total becomes 22)
- Hybrid burst remains +4 GPUs for spikes (auto-scale policy attached)
- Committed throughput bumped to 150k inference tokens/day to account for RankStack peak traffic
- Commercial: 12% discount on baseline reserved compute for 18-month term; Redwood will apply a $18,000 onboarding credit if you sign within 10 business days
- Fallback/Rollback: explicit model downgrade path to 16k-context model with automated routing and cached prefixes to keep cost/P95 under control during incidents

Attached: SOW_StrataRetail_Dedicated_Addendum_v2.pdf (DocuSign-ready), updated capacity_plan_v3.xlsx. If this looks good I'll route the SOW for e-signature and generate a PO template for procurement. Proposed sign deadline: 2026-12-28 to hit Feb 1 go-live.

Cheers,
Marcus Lin
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.ai

Thanks — we reviewed internally and approved the SOW. I've uploaded the signed DocuSign copy and the PO to our vendor portal; attaching the PO here for your records. We will target Feb 1 for the production cutover. Procurement will raise the invoice on Jan 15 per the milestone schedule.
